description: Retrieval test set: question -> expected PDF page(s) in the 600i maintenance manual. A hit = an expected page appears in the top-k results. IMPORTANT: these 15 queries are SELF-AUTHORED from the same 600i PDF text layer that was used to tune the chunking and chunk-kind heuristics. This is an in-sample regression sanity check, NOT an out-of-sample generalization benchmark; a 100% score here does not predict performance on other manuals. Expected pages were read from the PDF text layer (pypdf); page index = the 'Page N of 29' label.
